mapper.select: SELECT n.* FROM sys_notice n LEFT JOIN sys_notice_read nr ON n.notice_id = nr.notice_id AND nr.user_id = #{userId} WHERE n.status = '0' AND nr.read_id IS NULL AND (n.target_roles IS NULL OR n.target_roles = '' OR FIND_IN_SET(#{roleId}, n.target_roles)) ORDER BY n.create_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_notice n LEFT JOIN sys_notice_read nr ON n.notice_id = nr.notice_id AND nr.user_id = #{userId} WHERE n.status = '0' AND nr.read_id IS NULL AND (n.target_roles IS NULL OR n.target_roles = '' OR FIND_IN_SET(#{roleId}, n.target_roles))

SELECT n.*, CASE WHEN nr.read_id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS is_read FROM sys_notice n LEFT JOIN sys_notice_read nr ON n.notice_id = nr.notice_id AND nr.user_id = #{userId} WHERE n.status = '0' AND (n.target_roles IS NULL OR n.target_roles = '' OR FIND_IN_SET(#{roleId}, n.target_roles)) ORDER BY n.create_time DESC
